# LuzTech Typography

> Official LuzTech visual identity reference: icons, typography, licenses, and brand assets.

## Site

- English: https://ui.luztech.dev.br/en-us/
- Português: https://ui.luztech.dev.br/pt-br/

## Sections

- Instructions: https://ui.luztech.dev.br/en-us/#instructions
- Licenses: https://ui.luztech.dev.br/en-us/#licenses
- Icons: https://ui.luztech.dev.br/en-us/#icons
- Font & Resources: https://ui.luztech.dev.br/en-us/#font

## Icon library

Every icon is available as an outlined SVG and as PNGs in multiple sizes, colors, and inverted variants.

URL pattern: /icons/<variant>/<size>/[inverted/]<color>.png

Variants: clean, name, blog, nfse
Sizes: 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024
Colors: black, white, color

Full icon map: https://ui.luztech.dev.br/icons.json

## Font

- Space Grotesk (variable font, SIL Open Font License 1.1)
- Google Fonts: https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Space+Grotesk
- GitHub: https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk
